chain: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 360 420" role="img"><style>text{font:16px Arial;fill:#173c45}.b{font-weight:bold}</style><rect x="5" y="5" width="350" height="74" rx="10" fill="#eef7f6" stroke="#a3bfc0"/><text class="b" x="17" y="32">Same physical input → sensor</text><text x="17" y="58">Compare three alternative paths:</text><path d="M30 79V360M30 140H60m-5-5 5 5-5 5M30 240H60m-5-5 5 5-5 5M30 340H60m-5-5 5 5-5 5" stroke="#173c45" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/><rect x="65" y="100" width="290" height="80" rx="10" fill="#eef7f6" stroke="#a3bfc0"/><text class="b" x="78" y="129">A: RC low-pass → ADC</text><text x="78" y="155">Analog filtering before sampling</text><rect x="65" y="200" width="290" height="80" rx="10" fill="#eef7f6" stroke="#a3bfc0"/><text class="b" x="78" y="229">B: ADC → moving average</text><text x="78" y="255">Digital filtering on raw samples</text><rect x="65" y="300" width="290" height="80" rx="10" fill="#eef7f6" stroke="#a3bfc0"/><text class="b" x="78" y="329">C: ADC → EMA</text><text x="78" y="355">Digital filtering on raw samples</text><text x="10" y="407">Retain raw data and compare each decision.</text></svg>
export: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 360 387" role="img"><style>text{font:17px Arial;fill:#173c45}.b{font-weight:bold}</style><rect x="5" y="5" width="350" height="113" rx="10" fill="#eef7f6" stroke="#a3bfc0"/><text class="b" x="15" y="30">Review identity, originals and</text><text class="b" x="15" y="52">revisions</text><text x="15" y="74">Disclose support and any answer</text><text x="15" y="96">exposure honestly.</text><path d="M180 120v15m-5-5 5 5 5-5" fill="none" stroke="#173c45" stroke-width="2"/><rect x="5" y="138" width="350" height="113" rx="10" fill="#eef7f6" stroke="#a3bfc0"/><text class="b" x="15" y="163">Finalize → evidence ZIP + JSON</text><text class="b" x="15" y="185">backup</text><text x="15" y="207">Finalization locks responses. Keep the</text><text x="15" y="229">downloaded files.</text><path d="M180 253v15m-5-5 5 5 5-5" fill="none" stroke="#173c45" stroke-width="2"/><rect x="5" y="271" width="350" height="91" rx="10" fill="#eef7f6" stroke="#a3bfc0"/><text class="b" x="15" y="296">Submission is a separate action</text><text x="15" y="318">Follow the published assignment; this</text><text x="15" y="340">file uploads nothing.</text></svg>
handoff: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 360 387" role="img"><style>text{font:17px Arial;fill:#173c45}.b{font-weight:bold}</style><rect x="5" y="5" width="350" height="91" rx="10" fill="#eef7f6" stroke="#a3bfc0"/><text class="b" x="15" y="30">Propose an observable comparison</text><text x="15" y="52">Same raw input, units, sampling and</text><text x="15" y="74">steady analysis window.</text><path d="M180 98v15m-5-5 5 5 5-5" fill="none" stroke="#173c45" stroke-width="2"/><rect x="5" y="116" width="350" height="113" rx="10" fill="#eef7f6" stroke="#a3bfc0"/><text class="b" x="15" y="141">Check the useful event as well as</text><text class="b" x="15" y="163">noise</text><text x="15" y="185">Measure event height and response</text><text x="15" y="207">time; retain raw data.</text><path d="M180 231v15m-5-5 5 5 5-5" fill="none" stroke="#173c45" stroke-width="2"/><rect x="5" y="249" width="350" height="113" rx="10" fill="#eef7f6" stroke="#a3bfc0"/><text class="b" x="15" y="274">Let the lab instructor specify</text><text class="b" x="15" y="296">apparatus</text><text x="15" y="318">This simulation does not confirm</text><text x="15" y="340">Monday’s sensor or circuit.</text></svg>
mechanism: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 360 343" role="img"><style>text{font:17px Arial;fill:#173c45}.b{font-weight:bold}</style><rect x="5" y="5" width="350" height="91" rx="10" fill="#eef7f6" stroke="#a3bfc0"/><text class="b" x="15" y="30">Moving average: a trailing window</text><text x="15" y="52">Current sample and previous two,</text><text x="15" y="74">all with equal weights.</text><path d="M180 98v15m-5-5 5 5 5-5" fill="none" stroke="#173c45" stroke-width="2"/><rect x="5" y="116" width="350" height="91" rx="10" fill="#eef7f6" stroke="#a3bfc0"/><text class="b" x="15" y="141">EMA: one stored output</text><text x="15" y="163">Blend the current input with</text><text x="15" y="185">the previous filtered output.</text><path d="M180 209v15m-5-5 5 5 5-5" fill="none" stroke="#173c45" stroke-width="2"/><rect x="5" y="227" width="350" height="91" rx="10" fill="#eef7f6" stroke="#a3bfc0"/><text class="b" x="15" y="252">Both are causal</text><text x="15" y="274">Only current/past values are used; no</text><text x="15" y="296">future samples.</text></svg>
predict: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 360 343" role="img"><style>text{font:17px Arial;fill:#173c45}.b{font-weight:bold}</style><rect x="5" y="5" width="350" height="91" rx="10" fill="#eef7f6" stroke="#a3bfc0"/><text class="b" x="15" y="30">First: write a prediction</text><text x="15" y="52">State the mechanism, assumptions and</text><text x="15" y="74">uncertainty.</text><path d="M180 98v15m-5-5 5 5 5-5" fill="none" stroke="#173c45" stroke-width="2"/><rect x="5" y="116" width="350" height="91" rx="10" fill="#eef7f6" stroke="#a3bfc0"/><text class="b" x="15" y="141">Then: preserve your first attempt</text><text x="15" y="163">Original wording stays locked; the</text><text x="15" y="185">comparison is revealed.</text><path d="M180 209v15m-5-5 5 5 5-5" fill="none" stroke="#173c45" stroke-width="2"/><rect x="5" y="227" width="350" height="91" rx="10" fill="#eef7f6" stroke="#a3bfc0"/><text class="b" x="15" y="252">Finally: inspect and revise</text><text x="15" y="274">Use evidence to revise. A preserved</text><text x="15" y="296">answer is not a grade.</text></svg>
